supersession.reason: Remediates T4B9-HIGH-003 and T4B9-HIGH-004 by replacing six compound records with separately identified atomic records, correcting collision metadata, removing the unsupported projectile-speed sign assertion, and giving FIX-004 a nonempty exact Git object-type source check.
supersession.scope_limit: Evidence remediation only. No product source, browser observation, completion result, candidate, acceptance, or accepted manifest is changed.

claim_contract.text_envelope: UTF-8 Git-blob bytes for inclusive LF-terminated lines; cited_range_sha256 hashes exactly those bytes.
claim_contract.binary_envelope: Whole-file zero-based inclusive byte range; blob_sha256 and cited_range_sha256 equal the exact bytes.
claim_contract.atomicity_rule: Each record states one independently falsifiable proposition. semantic_assertion is evaluated against that record's exact cited bytes.
claim_contract.temporal_rule: Historical and baseline-only records do not establish current runtime behavior.
